assets.name: kvartal-right.png
assets.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup.
Asset type: original photographic bitmap background for an app coupon preview, portrait orientation 1024x1536.
Style/medium: premium photorealistic studio product photography with realistic materials, refined art direction, crisp yet natural details.
Composition/framing: design the full uncropped portrait canvas. Keep the entire top 55 percent clear of objects, and keep the left 55 percent mostly open backdrop throughout, for native app typography added later. Cluster all main physical subjects in the lower-right corner. A photographed set with no border.
Constraints: absolutely no letters, words, numerals, typography, brand marks, logos, label designs, pricing, coupons, UI, frames, watermarks, stickers, barcodes or promotional badges. Any packaging must be wholly blank and unbranded. This image contains only products and the physical studio backdrop.
Primary request: vibrant vermilion orange wall with fine tactile material texture and terracotta stone ledge in the bottom portion, a large unbranded blank orange foil potato chips bag at the lower right, black ceramic bowl filled with ridged potato crisps just below and slightly left of the bag, and a few loose crisps nearby. The bag is orange on orange with convincing glossy folds and sealed edges. Directional studio sunlight casts strong elegant shadows. Palette: vermilion orange, terracotta, black ceramic, golden crisps. Product cluster should remain wholly below midpoint; bag mostly in rightmost 40 percent.
assets.inspection: Visually inspected: photorealistic, blank packaging, no text/logos/UI, large open upper and left background. Subjects cluster lower-right.
